patch_resolves_note: The staged fixed source replaces `buffer->merge_out_clusters(start, j)` with `buffer->merge_clusters(start, j)`, which keeps Arabic mark reordering on the live `buffer->info` stream. The toolkit wrapper's fixed `run --version fixed` log reported a `/bin/arvo` rc139, but direct execution of the same instrumented `/out/hb-fuzzer /tmp/poc` inside the fixed workspace was clean and exercised `arabic_merge_choice` with `merge_target_ptr == live_info_ptr`, so the required source-level repair is genuinely witnessed.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the Arabic in-place reorder merges clusters for `[start, j)`, the merge target must be the current `buffer->info` stream rather than the stale `buffer->out_info` array left behind by `swap_buffers()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing current-buffer selection at the wrong helper call in `reorder_marks_arabic()`. On the vulnerable path, the code uses the stale out-buffer helper and therefore selects `buffer->out_info` even though the second normalization round is already operating on the live in-place `info` stream.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable trace, `arabic_merge_choice` executes and records `merge_target_ptr != live_info_ptr`. In the fixed clean run, the same protected event executes and records `merge_target_ptr == live_info_ptr`, so the missing obligation is differentially verified without perturbation.

nodes.state: At the selected `merge_out_clusters()` sink, the cluster-extension read begins with `start >= out_len`, so `out_info[start]` is taken from a stale out-buffer index beyond the prefix that was live on this path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `merge_start_index=17` and `stale_out_len=16` at `merge_out_clusters_sink`.

nodes.state: After `swap_buffers()`, `out_info` is the previous `info` allocation while `info` is the new live glyph stream, so the out-buffer name now refers to stale pre-decomposition storage.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `stale_out_info_ptr == previous_info_ptr` at `swap_buffers_state`, while the same event also shows a distinct `live_info_ptr`.

edges.relation: The stale `out_info` pointer installed by `swap_buffers()` is the same pointer selected as the merge target at the Arabic reorder call site.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records the same pointer value for `swap_buffers_state.stale_out_info_ptr` and `arabic_merge_choice.merge_target_ptr`.

edges.relation: The exact merge target pointer chosen at `reorder_marks_arabic()` becomes the `out_info` base consumed by `merge_out_clusters()` at the sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records the same pointer value for `arabic_merge_choice.merge_target_ptr` and `merge_out_clusters_sink.sink_buffer_ptr`.
